jobs.description:
Job Title:
Lead Program Manager
Job Description
We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

As a Lead Program Manager, you will lead strategic planning, execution, governance, and continuous improvement of large-scale automotive programs supporting OEMs, dealer networks, training consulting leads, and automotive retail initiatives. In this role, you will serve as the primary leader coordinating cross-functional teams across strategy, IT, analytics and reporting, client services, technology, creative services, and operations to deliver measurable business outcomes. What you will do in this role
In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.
Some key responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Lead end-to-end delivery of large, multi-million-dollar automotive programs across OEM, dealer network, and consultants
- Manage dependencies across multiple workstreams, vendors, platforms, and stakeholders to keep programs moving forward.
- Serve as the primary program lead for OEM and dealer-facing stakeholders, building trusted relationships with executive sponsors and key decision-makers.
- Excel skills (Advanced Excel skills including complex data manipulation) and understanding of sales trends and objectives
- Ability to understand multiple workstreams regarding reporting information that may contain multiple excel files from OEM and support client with long term plan to automate
- Ability to work with several different client business owners with different requirements which relate to the overall business objectives as a whole
- Evaluate new technologies, AI capabilities, and automation opportunities that align with business objectives
- Drive operational excellence through standardized processes, governance discipline, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Work alongside other Program Managers and help coordinate deliverables and objectives with Operations teams, Data Analysts, Creative Teams, Technology Teams, Operations Leaders, and Vendor Partners.
- Define priorities and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and high performance
- Collaboration with existing Program Managers well versed in the day to day requirements of the program
- Identify risks impacting profitability, delivery commitments, capacity planning, and staffing strategies.

- Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, risk registers, governance frameworks, and delivery plans.
- Establish program KPIs, business outcome measures, and performance reporting aligned with client objectives.
- Facilitate quarterly business reviews, executive briefings, and strategic planning sessions.
- Translate client business objectives into actionable marketing, technology, analytics, and operational initiatives.
- Ensure alignment between OEM brand standards and retailer marketing execution.

- Manage program budgets, forecasts, resource plans, and financial performance against contractual and operational targets
- Drive innovation through personalization, segmentation, and data-driven marketing approaches.
- Develop executive dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into program health and business impact.

Your qualifications
We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you:
- Have deep automotive industry knowledge, including experience supporting OEMs, dealer networks, or automotive retail initiatives.
- Bring strong program management expertise with the ability to lead complex, large-scale marketing programs from strategy through execution.
- Strong excel skills and understanding of Power BI Platform and sales reporting
- Can build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, client partners, dealer-facing teams, vendors, and cross-functional delivery teams.
- Are skilled at translating business objectives into clear roadmaps, workstreams, deliverables, KPIs, and measurable outcomes.
- Have experience leading teams across marketing strategy, analytics, client services, technology, creative services, operations, and vendor partners.
- Use data to assess program performance, results, risks, and opportunities.
- Are comfortable managing budgets, forecasts, resource plans, risks, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
- Communicate clearly and confidently in internal and client facing meetings.
- Thrive in a fast-paced environment where collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement matter.

It will be a plus if you:
- Have experience with Salesforce, Automotive Cloud, Dealer Management Systems, Customer Data Platforms, or marketing automation technologies.
- Have experience using AI or automation tools to improve productivity
- Have experience developing executive dashboards, governance frameworks, risk registers, and performance reporting.

What's in it for you
We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.
In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:

The base salary range for this position is $85,000 - $100,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.
The deadline to apply for this position is: October 16, 2026. This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

Power the best version of you!
At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.
If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”

jobs.location: BEN COTONOU - Parcel F et G , Quartier Enagnon 4eme Arrondissement îlot 40002
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Professionnel(le) I – Planification et Analyse Financière (FP&A)
Job Description
1- Qui sommes-nous ?
Concentrix est un leader mondial de l’expérience client, présent dans plus de 70 pays. Chez Concentrix Bénin, nous plaçons l’humain, l’innovation et l’excellence opérationnelle au cœur de nos activités.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de notre département Finance, nous recherchons un(e) Professionnel(le) I – Planification et Analyse Financière (FP&A) capable de contribuer au pilotage de la performance financière de l’entreprise à travers la production de reportings financiers et opérationnels, l’analyse des résultats, le suivi budgétaire et la préparation des prévisions financières.

Le/La titulaire du poste contribuera à garantir la fiabilité, la qualité et la pertinence des informations financières utilisées par le management pour le suivi de la performance et la prise de décision. Il/Elle participera également aux processus de clôture, de budget, de Forecast et de Rolling Forecast ainsi qu’à l’amélioration continue des outils et processus de reporting financier.

2- Pourquoi rejoindre Concentrix ?
En rejoignant Concentrix Bénin, vous intégrerez un environnement international, dynamique et multiculturel, où la collaboration, le développement des compétences et l’amélioration continue occupent une place importante.
Vous aurez l’opportunité de contribuer directement au pilotage de la performance financière de l’organisation, de travailler avec les équipes opérationnelles et les fonctions support et de participer à des processus financiers structurants tels que le reporting, la budgétisation, le Forecast et le Rolling Forecast.

3-Mission principale
Contribuer au pilotage de la performance financière de l'entreprise en assurant la préparation des reportings financiers, l'analyse des résultats, le suivi budgétaire et la production de prévisions financières fiables. Le titulaire du poste accompagne les opérations et les fonctions support dans la compréhension des résultats financiers et l'identification des leviers d'amélioration de la performance. Les activités FP&A au sein de Concentrix s'appuient notamment sur les processus de budgétisation, reporting, analyse des écarts et forecast.

4- Principales responsabilités et activités

A-Reporting financier
Participer aux clôtures mensuelles.
Préparer et consolider les reportings financiers et opérationnels.
Contrôler la fiabilité, l'exhaustivité et la cohérence des données financières.
Assurer le rapprochement entre les données de gestion et la comptabilité.
Produire les indicateurs clés de performance dans le respect du calendrier de clôture.

B-Analyse financière
Analyser les écarts entre Réalisé, Budget, Forecast et Rolling Forecast.
Identifier les facteurs expliquant les variations de chiffre d'affaires, de marge brute et de NGOI.
Réaliser des analyses de rentabilité par client, projet, site ou département.
Préparer des synthèses et recommandations à destination du management.
Participer aux revues mensuelles de performance.

C- Budget et prévisions
Participer à l'élaboration du budget annuel.
Contribuer aux exercices de Forecast et Rolling Forecast.
Collecter et consolider les hypothèses opérationnelles et financières.
Assurer le suivi des objectifs budgétaires et des plans d'action associés.
Participer à l'identification des risques et opportunités financiers.

D-Business Partnering
Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles et les fonctions support.
Fournir des analyses permettant d'éclairer la prise de décision.
Accompagner les responsables opérationnels dans le suivi de leurs indicateurs de performance.
Participer aux réunions de gestion et aux revues financières.

5-Profil recherché

A- Formation
Bac +4/5 en Finance, Contrôle de Gestion, Comptabilité, Audit ou domaine équivalent.

B- Expérience
Première expérience en contrôle de gestion, FP&A, audit ou finance d'entreprise appréciée.
Connaissance des activités de reporting et de planification financière.

C- Compétences techniques
Maîtrise avancée d'Excel.
Bonne compréhension des états financiers et des indicateurs de performance.
Capacités d'analyse financière et de modélisation.
Maîtrise des outils de reporting et de planification financière.
Connaissance des outils tels que Excel, Power BI, Planful, Domo et Workday.

D- Compétences comportementales
Forte capacité d'analyse et de synthèse.
Rigueur et sens de l'organisation.
Esprit d'équipe.
Orientation résultats.
Excellentes capacités de communication.
Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément.

6- Langues
Français : Courant
Anglais : Courant
Bilingue français/anglais (oral et écrit), avec capacité à interagir quotidiennement avec des équipes et parties prenantes internationales.

7- Principaux indicateurs de performance
Respect du calendrier de clôture.
Qualité et fiabilité des reportings financiers.
Précision des forecasts et budgets.
Respect des délais de production des analyses.
Pertinence des recommandations fournies au management.

8- Outils utilisés
Microsoft Excel
Power BI
Planful
Domo
Workday

jobs.title: Program Manager, Marketing Solutions
jobs.location: CAN, ON, Work-at-Home
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Program Manager, Marketing Solutions
Job Description
We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.
Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.
Position Summary
As a Program Manager , you will plan, coordinate, and deliver automotive marketing and customer engagement programs from initiation through completion. You will manage project schedules, budgets, scopes, risks, and cross-functional teams to ensure CRM, digital, direct mail, loyalty, retention, and customer lifecycle marketing initiatives are delivered accurately, on time, and within budget.

This role is ideal for a highly organized, collaborative, and client-focused professional who is comfortable working across multiple teams, presenting to stakeholders, and managing competing priorities with limited direction.

What you will do in this role:

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.
- Manage end-to-end execution of automotive marketing campaigns and client projects
- Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, budgets, forecasts, status reports, and project documentation
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Creative, Development, Analytics, QA, Production, Client Success, technology teams, and vendor partners
- Facilitate client and internal stakeholder meetings, gather requirements, and document business objectives
- Create and deliver clear, polished PowerPoint presentations for internal teams and client-facing discussions
- Monitor project scope, risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests, escalating when appropriate
- Ensure campaign deliverables meet quality standards, business requirements, and client expectations
- Support estimates, statements of work, billing requirements, and project financial tracking
- Track project performance against key success measures, including on-time delivery, budget adherence, client satisfaction, quality, and stakeholder communication
- Maintain strong client relationships through proactive communication, follow-up, confidentiality, and issue resolution
- Work independently with minimal direction while keeping teams aligned, informed, and accountable
- Support one or multiple client accounts depending on business needs and skill set
- Drive process improvements and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency
- Balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment with flexibility, sound judgment, and an open-minded approach
- Travel locally for client visits as needed, up to 10% or less

Your qualifications
We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you :
- Have 6–7 years of experience in project management, marketing campaign management, client delivery, or a related field
- Bring a combination of relevant education and experience; a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Project Management, Business, or a related field is preferred
- Have experience managing marketing campaigns, customer engagement programs, CRM initiatives, digital marketing, direct mail, loyalty, retention, or customer lifecycle programs
- Are highly organized and able to manage timelines, budgets, deliverables, documentation, risks, and stakeholder expectations
- Communicate clearly and professionally, with strong English written and verbal communication skills
- Are comfortable presenting to internal stakeholders and clients, including developing polished PowerPoint presentations
- Work well independently and collaboratively, with the ability to move initiatives forward without needing significant direction
- Are a strong team player who can build trust across cross-functional teams and client groups
- Can manage multiple priorities, shifting deadlines, and either single-client or multi-client project environments
- Demonstrate flexibility, open-mindedness, discretion, and a strong commitment to confidentiality
- Are proficient with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Teams, project management tools, reporting processes, and documentation practices
- Have advanced Excel skills, including the ability to organize, analyze, and report on project or financial information
- Are comfortable with light local travel for client visits

It will be a plus if you:
- Are bilingual in English and French
- Have experience working in the automotive industry
- Have Salesforce experience
- Have experience working directly with clients and supporting client-facing project delivery
- Have experience supporting statements of work, estimates, billing, forecasting, or project financial tracking
- Bring strong process improvement skills and a continuous improvement mindset

What's in it for you
We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.
In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:

The base salary range for this position is $60k- $70k, plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, registered retirement savings plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days. The deadline to apply for this position is Oct 12, 2026.
This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

As part of the hiring process, candidates may be required to undergo background screening and identity verification, where permitted by applicable law and consistent with the requirements of the role.  Certain verification processes used by the Company or its service providers may involve technologies that rely on biometric identifiers or biometric information, where permitted by law.  If biometric identifiers or biometric information are collected, used, or stored, the Company will provide the legally required disclosures and obtain any required written consent prior to such collection, and will handle such information in accordance with applicable biometric privacy laws and Company policies.

Power the best version of you!
At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.
If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”
